reason: I like the idea and the WhatsApp reminders would make my shop look modern, but I mostly cut hair myself with one chair, so staff selfies and attendance are for bigger salons. ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month is too much for what I would actually use.
objection: If my phone breaks or gets stolen, do I lose all my customers and bills? Nothing here says the data is backed up somewhere safe.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and a small-shop plan around ₹399 a month, with a clear promise that my customer data is saved online and I can get it back on a new phone.
